purpose: Report a generally accepted view without naming its holder.
keywords: Plain clause + とされる / とされている
This bridge is considered the oldest in the country.
The cause is thought to be an electrical failure.
Spring is considered the best season in this area.
formation: Plain clause + とされる / とされている
restrictions: Often introduces scholarly or institutional assessments.
mistake: It attributes a view; it does not independently prove it.
